desc: Implement `feasible(L, s, numOps)` DP: state `dp[c][len]` (min flips) updated by processing each character, with two choices (flip or not), enforcing run length ≤ L.
In `minLength`, binary search smallest L in `[1, n]` such that `feasible(L, s, numOps)` is True; return L.
Test edge cases: all-same string with various numOps, alternating string, numOps=0, numOps large, n=1.
